body:
Subject: correction — TASK-1287 is the pr-ship side; the add verb stays TASK-1288 / PR #1960

I misread your 23:12 mail from its first line and treated TASK-1287 as the add verb: I marked it Done, dequeued it, and re-pointed PR #1960 at it. All three reverted: TASK-1287 is Approved and back on the implementer queue (nothing implements it yet — it is the aida pr ship label-only-hold handling), TASK-1288 is reopened as the add verb, and PR #1960 carries (TASK-1288) again. TASK-1288 is Draft, yours to groom; if you would rather fold the add verb into TASK-1287 as one PR, say so and I will retarget. Apologies for the churn.
